definitions.explanation: Feeling nervous or uncomfortable around others, especially in unfamiliar social situations. A loanword used as a na-adjective.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シャイな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
シャイで⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけられない→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm too shy to start conversations myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シャイな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that many Japanese people are shy.

notes:
シャイ is a loanword from English "shy."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: a shy person (native Japanese word, refers to the person themselves)
- ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧: introverted, shy (more about personality disposition)
- ⟦{人見知|ひとみし}り→人見知り：06622_hitomishiri⟧: shy around strangers (especially used for children)

シャイ is used casually in conversation. In more formal writing, ⟦{内気|うちき}→内気：16836_uchiki⟧ or {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ would be more natural.
